description: Configuration management for the Backend Service, including environment variable setup, defaults, and settings encapsulated in a dataclass. Provides runtime configuration for server host, ports, directories, debugging, CORS policies, language model and speech-to-text provider settings, and alignment/timing parameters.

classes.name: Settings
classes.description: Dataclass encapsulating all configuration parameters for the backend service, including server settings, directories, provider credentials, and alignment options.

methods.name: Settings get_settings()
methods.description: Loads configuration from environment variables, applies defaults, and caches the result for reuse.
